properties.notes: Buildings and land within town centre that may have potential for redevelopment through a combination of conversion and new-build development. Around two-thirds of the site is vacant. A previous outline permission lapsed without commencement, although this scheme related to a much larger area of land. This was for construction of 41 units following demolition and 7 apartments through conversion and change of use (09/00040/OUT). However, an indicative capacity of 5 units is considered appropriate for this smaller parcel of land.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
